---
title: Listings
description: Pages that list other pages as rows, as cards or as a table, with categories and a feed.
order: 6
---

A listing is a page that lists other pages, as in Quarto. A page with `listing:` in its front matter is
a listing. The [News](../news/index.qmd) page is a listing. The cards of the guide on the
[home page](../index.qmd) are a listing too.

```yaml
---
title: News
listing:
  contents: posts          # a folder, or globs, from the folder of this page
  type: default            # default, grid or table
  sort: "date desc"        # or a list: ["date desc", "title"]; false keeps the order found
  categories: true         # the categories at the right: true, numbered, unnumbered or cloud
  feed: true               # an RSS feed beside the page; it needs website.site-url
---
```

## What an item shows

Each item of a listing is a page. smalldocs reads the fields of the item from the page:

| Field | From |
|---|---|
| `title`, `subtitle`, `author`, `date`, `categories` | The front matter |
| `description` | The front matter, or the first paragraph of the page |
| `image` | The front matter, or the first picture in the page |
| `reading-time`, `word-count` | Counted from the page |
| `filename`, `file-modified` | The file |

To choose the fields and their order, write for example `fields: [title, date, description]`.

## The types of listing

`default`
: A row for each page. The date and the author are on the left. The title and the description are in
  the middle, and the picture is on the right.

`grid`
: A card for each page. The option `grid-columns` sets the number of cards in a row. The default is 3.
  The picture is at the top of each card, at the height of `image-height`.

`table`
: A row for each page, and a column for each field.

## Other options

| Option | What it does |
|---|---|
| `id` | The id of the listing. If the page has an empty div with this id, the listing goes there. If not, it goes at the end |
| `max-items` | Show this number of items at most |
| `page-size` | Show this number of items on each page of the listing; 50 by default |
| `sort-ui`, `filter-ui` | A box to sort and a box to filter. They are on for `default` and `table` |
| `max-description-length` | Cut a description after this number of characters; 175 by default |
| `date-format` | For example `MMMM D, YYYY`, or `iso`, `long`, `medium` or `short` |
| `include`, `exclude` | Keep or remove items by field, for example `include: {categories: news}` |
| `field-display-names` | The heading of a column in a table |
| `grid-item-align`, `grid-item-border` | The alignment and the border of a card |
| `table-striped`, `table-hover` | The look of a table |

A category on a post links to the listing, which then shows only the posts of that category. A click
on a category in a listing does the same.
